operating_notes.text: Floor price for voluntary delisting determined at ₹252 per share with an indicative price of ₹353 per share.
Mrs. Prerana Jadhav (Peer Review No. 2751/2022) replaced M/s. Robert Pavrey & Associates LLP as peer review company secretary for the delisting due diligence and audit.
Delisting exit price set at ₹426 per share, higher than the discovered price of ₹425.
Promoter group holding reached 91.96% following the delisting offer.
Corrigendum issued for delisting outcome; 100 physical shares were tendered and rejected, bringing validly tendered shares to 30,09,593.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹166 Cr (+11.2% YoY), net profit ₹8.89 Cr (+780.2% YoY).
2026-05-25: Promoter-group entity Kreo Capital issued the Initial Public Announcement for a voluntary delisting offer for all public shares of Hitech Corporation from BSE and NSE.

2026-05-26: Hitech Corporation filed the Initial Public Announcement for a voluntary delisting offer by promoter-group entity Geetanjali Trading and Investments at an indicative ₹353/share, above the ₹351.35 lifetime high.
Hitech Corporation disclosed a floor price of ₹252 and an indicative price of ₹353 per share for its proposed voluntary delisting.
2026-06-04: Board appointed Mrs. Prerana Jadhav as peer review company secretary for the delisting due diligence, after M/s. Robert Pavrey & Associates LLP cited unavailability.
Hitech Corporation announced that its voluntary delisting offer was successful with promoter shareholding reaching 92.67% at a discovered price of ₹425 per share.
Hitech Corporation's delisting offer was declared successful with the promoter group reaching a 91.96% stake at an exit price of ₹426 per share.
Hitech Corporation issued a corrigendum to its delisting outcome, confirming the offer remains successful with a 91.96% promoter stake.
